actions.description: Reads the configured connection and linked Sessions for an exact entry. First resolve a GitHub issue or pull request URL with entries/resolve-resource-v1, or search entries/search-v1. Pass v:1, its entryRef and sourceInstanceId from sourceInstance.sourceInstanceId. On kind read, result.instance is the configured instance required by source read and mutation Actions. The localRef uses kindId, collisionScope and entryId from entryRef; routingToken comes from the resolved locator. Non-secret configuration: instance.configuration.token contains source-selection data, not a credential. Copy the entire returned instance unchanged into source read and mutation Action inputs; never replace its configuration with [REDACTED]. Credentials are acquired internally through the account binding. Keep configuration contents out of user-facing prose. No mounted UI is required.
actions.title: Read the durable facts of one entry

actions.description: Resolve a GitHub issue or pull request URL before pin issue, unpin, subscribe or other source Actions, without scanning the list. Pass v:1 and resource:{kind:"issue",url:"https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues/NUMBER"}; pull requests use kind:"pullRequest" and /pull/NUMBER. The resolved result contains entryRef, sourceInstance and locator.routingToken. Next call happier.triage/actions/entries/read-detail-v1 with v:1, entryRef and sourceInstanceId:sourceInstance.sourceInstanceId to obtain result.instance. For source Actions, use that instance, localRef:{kindId,collisionScope,entryId} from entryRef, and routingToken from locator.routingToken. Keep these returned values unchanged; do not invent routing fields. The returned instance.configuration.token is non-secret source-selection data required by source Actions; pass it unchanged rather than substituting [REDACTED], while keeping its contents out of user-facing prose. A missing route or unavailable result cannot be used for a write.
actions.title: Resolve a GitHub issue or other resource URL
